Defined_Rx.NumberOfAntennas_comment: 1, 2, 3, 4. Used when Channel_Defects.json has any Mode set to 1: Decimate_Payload_Rx.py takes this many rays from File_Rx.Waveform_Payload_DefectsModeled_Rx. More than 1: steps 4-6 run per antenna (--ray N), Combine_Antennas_Rx.py combines them (MRC), steps 7-9 use the _Combined files. Run_Rx_Chain.py does it all.
Defined_Rx.NumberOfTxAntennas_comment: 1, 2. Transmit antennas, set from the control field (NoOfTxAntenna). Not the same as NumberOfAntennas (receive antennas)
Defined_Rx.ClientFlag_comment: Service, Client. Set from the control field
Defined_Rx.C_init_Dat_comment: 0 to 255. Gold code id that descrambles the payload. Set from the control field (C_init)
Defined_Rx.EqualizerMaxDoppler_comment: Hz, worst-case Doppler for the LMMSE and PCA time filter
Defined_Rx.Use_Preamble_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1. 0 does not attach the preamble for testing purposes
Defined_Rx.Use_ControlField_comment: 0 or 1. Default is 1. Must match the Tx. 1: Process_Control_Field_Rx.py decodes the control field after Packet_Detector.py, sets RefSymbolSpacing, RefSignalSpacing, PacketLength, Mod, NumberOfTxAntennas, EncoderBlockSize, EncoderCodeRate, Repetition and ClientFlag from it (running Initialize_Rx.py if any changed) and cuts it off the packet
